title: Language models for text classification: From bag-of-words to Jev
summary: This article by Sebastian Raschka traces the historical evolution of text classification techniques, from traditional bag-of-words approaches through word embeddings to modern transformer-based models, providing valuable context on how NLP has progressed over time.
problem_solved: Explains how text classification methods evolved from simple statistical approaches to sophisticated neural network architectures.
why_valuable: Provides historical context and technical depth from a recognized ML expert, helping practitioners understand the progression of NLP techniques.
